entities.summary: Manchu, a notable figure in the history of South Korea, associated with Joseon Dynasty (1636–1897). Preceded by Late Joseon and Hermit Kingdom and Toyotomi Hideyoshi. Their legacy influenced Japan forces the Treaty of Ganghwa — opening Korea to foreign trade and Japan formally annexes Korea — beginning 35 years of colonial rule.
